lessons: Keep the existing diff: stat-before-read replay cap, per-report quarantine, *.report.json selection, custody check in Box.enqueue, and serve/daemon inbox wiring all pass the gates. Fix only the four review findings.

serve.py box(): if inbox is set, call inbox.consume() first. Then run box_consumer only if triage.box.pending() is non-empty. An idle inbox must not append a triage_pass journal record on every poll.

inbox.py: before reading a *.report.json, stat its size against a fixed limit (LOG_EXCERPT_LIMIT plus metadata headroom) and reject it if larger. After a filed or duplicate outcome, rename the report out of the scan glob (e.g. .filed).
Keep run.md's six sections with `## Outcome` exactly `ok`. Rerun all three verification commands green before finishing.
